import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final double EPS = 1e-9;
    static final double PI = Math.acos(-1.0);
    static final int MOD = 1000 * 1000 * 1000 + 7;
    static final int INF = 2000 * 1000 * 1000;
    static final int[] dx = {1, 0, 0, -1};
    static final int[] dy = {0, 1, -1, 0};

    static int n, t;
    static char[][] a = new char[15][15];
    static char[][] b = new char[15][15];
    static int[][] dist = new int[15][15];
    static boolean[][] used = new boolean[15][15];
    static MaxFlow maxFlow;

    static int sqr(int n) {
        return n * n;
    }

    static class MaxFlow {
        ArrayList<Integer>[] g;
        ArrayList<Integer> to;
        ArrayList<Integer> flow;
        ArrayList<Integer> cap;
        boolean[] used;
        int lastEdge;

        @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
        MaxFlow(int nodes) {
            g = new ArrayList[nodes];
            for (int i = 0; i < nodes; i++) {
                g[i] = new ArrayList<>();
            }
            to = new ArrayList<>();
            flow = new ArrayList<>();
            cap = new ArrayList<>();
            used = new boolean[nodes];
            lastEdge = 0;
        }

        void addEdge(int from, int to, int cap) {
            this.to.add(to);
            this.flow.add(0);
            this.cap.add(cap);
            g[from].add(lastEdge++);

            this.to.add(from);
            this.flow.add(0);
            this.cap.add(0);
            g[to].add(lastEdge++);
        }

        boolean dfs(int v, int T, int curFlow) {
            if (v == T) return true;
            used[v] = true;
            for (int idx : g[v]) {
                if (!used[to.get(idx)] && cap.get(idx) - flow.get(idx) >= curFlow &&
                    dfs(to.get(idx), T, curFlow)) {
                    flow.set(idx, flow.get(idx) + curFlow);
                    flow.set(idx ^ 1, flow.get(idx ^ 1) - curFlow);
                    return true;
                }
            }
            return false;
        }

        int getMaxFlow(int S, int T) {
            int totalCap = 0;
            for (int idx : g[S]) totalCap += cap.get(idx);
            int curFlow = 1;
            while (curFlow <= totalCap) curFlow <<= 1;
            curFlow >>= 1;
            int resFlow = 0;
            while (curFlow > 0) {
                if (dfs(S, T, curFlow)) {
                    resFlow += curFlow;
                } else {
                    curFlow >>= 1;
                }
                Arrays.fill(used, false);
            }
            return resFlow;
        }
    }

    static boolean ok(int x, int y) {
        return 0 <= x && x < n &&
               0 <= y && y < n &&
               a[x][y] != 'Y' &&
               a[x][y] != 'Z';
    }

    static void bfsDeath(int x, int y) {
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            Arrays.fill(dist[i], INF);

        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        dist[x][y] = 0;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && dist[tx][ty] == INF) {
                    dist[tx][ty] = dist[curx][cury] + 1;
                    X.add(tx);
                    Y.add(ty);
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void runBFS(int x, int y) {
        Queue<Integer> X = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> Y = new LinkedList<>();
        Queue<Integer> lev = new LinkedList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) Arrays.fill(used[i], false);
        used[x][y] = true;
        X.add(x);
        Y.add(y);
        lev.add(0);

        while (!X.isEmpty()) {
            int curx = X.poll();
            int cury = Y.poll();
            int curlev = lev.poll();

            if (Character.isDigit(b[curx][cury]) && b[curx][cury] != '0') {
                maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + curx * n + cury, INF);
            }

            if (curlev >= t) continue;

            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
                int tx = curx + dx[k];
                int ty = cury + dy[k];
                if (ok(tx, ty) && !used[tx][ty]) {
                    if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev + 1) {
                        X.add(tx);
                        Y.add(ty);
                        lev.add(curlev + 1);
                    } else if (dist[tx][ty] > curlev && Character.isDigit(b[tx][ty]) && b[tx][ty] != '0') {
                        maxFlow.addEdge(x * n + y, sqr(n) + 1 + tx * n + ty, INF);
                    }
                    used[tx][ty] = true;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static void build() {
        int posi = -1, posj = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < n && posi == -1; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n && posi == -1; j++)
                if (a[i][j] == 'Z') { posi = i; posj = j; }

        bfsDeath(posi, posj);

        int totalNodes = 2 * n * n + 2;
        int S = totalNodes - 2;
        int T = totalNodes - 1;
        maxFlow = new MaxFlow(totalNodes);

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0')
                    maxFlow.addEdge(S, i * n + j, a[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(b[i][j]) && b[i][j] != '0')
                    maxFlow.addEdge(i * n + j + sqr(n) + 1, T, b[i][j] - '0');

        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++)
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++)
                if (Character.isDigit(a[i][j]) && a[i][j] != '0')
                    runBFS(i, j);

        System.out.println(maxFlow.getMaxFlow(S, T));
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
        n = Integer.parseInt(parts[0]);
        t = Integer.parseInt(parts[1]);
        br.readLine(); // skip newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                a[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        br.readLine(); // skip newline
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            String line = br.readLine();
            for (int j = 0; j < n; j++) {
                b[i][j] = line.charAt(j);
            }
        }
        build();
    }
}
